title: Registry: machine-readable status (System B JSON)
description: Runs `nexus status registry --json` — the machine-readable ClusterStatus over the 4 registry nodes for scripting/automation.

observe.what: a single JSON ClusterStatus document: 4 members with role + status, leader = the VIP-holding PG primary, Shards null

whatProves: The --json projection of GetStatusAsync gives a stable machine-readable contract for the registry tier (System B).
